goal: Speed up block validation and initial block download for blocks with Taproot spends
Reduces CPU costs for node operators by verifying Schnorr signatures in batches rather than individually
reviewability: Ready for review on the internal queue refactoring, though final integration depends on upstream secp256k1
agreement: Strong support after collaborative benchmarks and rework resolved early multithreading lock contention
Demonstrated significant validation speedups and helped design the per-thread batch architecture (Eunovo)
Anticipates major performance gains on recent Taproot-dense transaction volume (Sjors)
Early performance regression and mutex contention concerns were resolved in pushes (0xB10C, andrewtoth)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because Schnorr batch verification delivers a major algorithmic speedup for Taproot validation
Parallel block connection throughput more than doubles on blocks with heavy Schnorr signature counts
It also unblocks future batch Taproot tweak verification
